```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Topology is sound, but the current budget is wrong: M1 gets about 37 uA, so gm1 is too low for GBW. The mirror also delivers an off-target current, and the output DC is far from its design point. This edit sets the M1 current directly, derives the mirror ratio from it, and lowers the output DC target to cut pull-down current, keeping power near 137 uW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "L1":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # NMOS common-source length; short for more gds (bandwidth)
    "I1":    (52e-6, 44e-6, 60e-6),  # common-source bias current (sets gm1 for GBW)
    "VDS1":  (0.6, 0.5, 0.8),        # target output DC level (lower = less pull-down current)
    "RDC":   (6.0e4, 5.0e4, 8.0e4),  # pull-down resistor; sets conductance G for f3dB
    "gmid2": (12.0, 9.5, 12.0),      # PMOS load/reference gm/Id (higher = lower vdsat, more swing)
    "L2":    (0.25, 0.25, 0.3),      # PMOS load/reference length (same on M2 and M3)
    "IREF":  (4e-6, 3e-6, 6e-6),     # PMOS reference current (M3 diode)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)   # reference current sourced by the testbench
    I1 = p["I1"]
    VDS1 = p["VDS1"]
    RDC = p["RDC"]
    IREF = p["IREF"]
    L1 = p["L1"]
    L2 = p["L2"]
    VGS1 = 0.75                      # fixed gate drive of the common-source device

    # --- PMOS load mirror: M3 = 1x unit (diode), M2 = K x unit, same L ---
    # Ratio is derived from the required load current: I2 = I1 + VDS1/RDC
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], L2, IREF, vds=0.9)
    W_unit = opr.W
    I2_target = I1 + VDS1 / RDC
    K = I2_target / IREF
    op2 = lut.op("p", W_unit * K, L2, opr.vgs, VDS1)
    I2 = op2["Id"]

    # --- Common-source device: width set so it carries I1 at VDS1 ---
    t = lut.op("n", 10.0, L1, VGS1, VDS1)
    W1 = 10.0 * I1 / t["Id"]
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, VGS1, VDS1)

    # --- NMOS sink mirror: M0 diode at testbench iref, M4 width-scaled copy sinking IREF ---
    op0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    W4 = op0.W * IREF / iref
    L0 = 1.0

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_unit * K, L2)
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)
    n.M("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W4, L0)
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op0)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "vss", RDC)

    # --- analytic predictions ---
    gm1 = op1["gm"]
    gds1 = op1["gds"]
    gds2 = op2["gds"]
    G = gds1 + gds2 + 1.0 / RDC
    gain = gm1 / G
    f3db = G / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I2 + iref + IREF)
    swing = (VDD - opr.vdsat) - op1["vdsat"]

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": VDS1,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
